bundle.shortDescription: Modern video downloader built on yt-dlp and FFmpeg
bundle.longDescription: YT Downloader is a modern desktop workbench for downloading video and audio with yt-dlp and FFmpeg. It ships its own runtime, keeps every byte of user data beside the application and never touches the system drive.
